blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 ICH Q10 官方詞彙表中所有關鍵術語的英文原文定義，理解其來源（ICH Q8 / Q9 / Q10 / ISO 9000）
blocks.en: Master the original English definitions of all key terms in the official ICH Q10 glossary, and understand their sources (ICH Q8 / Q9 / Q10 / ISO 9000)

blocks.zh: 能辨識 Q8（Design Space、Control Strategy）與 Q9（QRM）與 Q10 詞彙表的重疊術語，理解 Q 三部曲的整合關係
blocks.en: Recognize the terms shared between the Q8 (Design Space, Control Strategy), Q9 (QRM) and Q10 glossaries, and understand how the three guidelines (Q8, Q9, Q10) fit together

blocks.zh: 理解 Annex 1 所描述的「四情境矩陣」：PQS 成熟度如何解鎖法規層面的彈性機會（風險導向稽查、科學導向審查）
blocks.en: Understand the "four-scenario matrix" described in Annex 1: how PQS maturity unlocks regulatory flexibility (risk-based inspection, science-based review)

blocks.zh: 能解讀 Annex 2 的 ICH Q10 PQS 模型圖：三大支柱（Management Responsibilities、PQS Enablers、PQS Elements）如何貫穿四大生命週期階段
blocks.en: Interpret the ICH Q10 PQS model diagram in Annex 2: how the three pillars (Management Responsibilities, PQS Enablers, PQS Elements) run through the four product lifecycle stages

blocks.zh: 能區分「State of Control（控制狀態）」與「State of Compliance（合規狀態）」的本質差異，並應用於 CDMO 品質系統成熟度評估
blocks.en: Distinguish between "State of Control" and "State of Compliance", and apply the difference when assessing the quality system maturity of a CDMO

blocks.en: 5. Glossary (from pages 17-19)

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 詞彙表架構說明
blocks.en: How the Glossary Is Built

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 的詞彙表有一個重要特點：它不是全部自行定義，而是優先借用現有的 ICH 和 ISO 定義，只有在找不到合適定義時才自行開發 Q10 定義。這體現了 ICH 指南的系統性與一致性。
blocks.en: The ICH Q10 glossary has one important feature: it does not define everything itself, but borrows existing ICH and ISO definitions first, and develops its own Q10 definition only when no suitable one exists. This reflects the systematic and consistent approach of ICH guidelines.

blocks.zh: ISO 9000:2005 來源：通用品質管理術語（如 Capability, Continual Improvement, Corrective/Preventive Action, Quality Manual, Quality Policy, Quality Planning）
blocks.en: Source: ISO 9000:2005: general quality management terms (e.g. Capability, Continual Improvement, Corrective/Preventive Action, Quality Manual, Quality Policy, Quality Planning)

blocks.zh: ICH Q8 來源：Design Space（藥品開發概念）
blocks.en: Source: ICH Q8: Design Space (a pharmaceutical development concept)

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 來源：Quality, Quality Risk Management
blocks.en: Source: ICH Q9: Quality, Quality Risk Management

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 自訂：Change Management, Control Strategy, Enabler, Knowledge Management, PQS, Product Realisation, State of Control 等核心概念
blocks.en: Defined in ICH Q10: core concepts such as Change Management, Control Strategy, Enabler, Knowledge Management, PQS, Product Realisation, State of Control

blocks.zh: 前幾個術語解析
blocks.en: Notes on the First Few Terms

blocks.zh: Capability of a Process（製程能力）：在統計意義上即 Cp/Cpk 指標。ICH Q10 刻意納入此術語，強調 State of Control 的量化面——你的製程不只要「合規」，更要有統計上的能力保證持續產出合格品。
blocks.en: Capability of a Process: in statistical terms, the Cp/Cpk indices. ICH Q10 deliberately includes this term to stress the quantitative side of State of Control: your process must not only be "compliant", it must also have the statistical capability to keep delivering acceptable product.

blocks.zh: Change Management（變更管理系統）：注意這是「系統性方法（systematic approach）」，包含 propose → evaluate → approve → implement → review 五步驟。與 CAPA 不同：CAPA 是針對問題的回應；Change Management 是針對任何變更（包括計劃性改善）的管控。
blocks.en: Change Management: note that this is a "systematic approach", comprising five steps: propose, evaluate, approve, implement, review. It differs from CAPA: CAPA is a response to a problem, whereas Change Management controls any change (including planned improvements).

blocks.zh: Continual Improvement（持續改善）：強調「recurring（反覆進行）」——持續改善不是一次性事件，是系統內建的機制。ISO 用 "continual"（間歇性的、有意識的）而非 "continuous"（不間斷的）。
blocks.en: Continual Improvement: emphasizes "recurring" activity. Continual improvement is not a one-off event but a mechanism built into the system. ISO uses "continual" (intermittent, deliberate) rather than "continuous" (uninterrupted).

blocks.zh: Control Strategy（控制策略）Q8Q10：這是 Q8 QbD 框架的輸出之一，也是 Q10 PQS 的核心工具。包含從 CQA 到 CPP/CMA 的完整控制網絡——不只是規格書，還包含監測頻率和方法。
blocks.en: Control StrategyQ8Q10: this is one of the outputs of the Q8 QbD framework and also a core tool of the Q10 PQS. It covers the whole control network from CQAs to CPPs/CMAs, and is more than a specification: it also includes monitoring frequency and methods.

blocks.zh: Design SpaceQ8：定義來自 Q8，但出現在 Q10 詞彙表中——這是 Q 三部曲整合的直接體現。
blocks.en: Design SpaceQ8: the definition comes from Q8 but appears in the Q10 glossary, a direct reflection of how Q8, Q9 and Q10 are integrated.

blocks.zh: Feedback / Feedforward：Q10 特別解釋這對概念既可用於技術層面（製程控制系統）也可用於管理層面（品質系統的資訊流）。
blocks.en: Feedback / Feedforward: Q10 specifically explains that this pair of concepts can be applied at the technical level (process control systems) as well as the management level (information flow in the quality system).

blocks.zh: 5. Glossary（續）｜Knowledge Management → State of Control
blocks.en: 5. Glossary (continued): Knowledge Management to State of Control

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text（續）
blocks.en: Original Text (continued)

blocks.zh: Knowledge Management（知識管理）
blocks.en: Knowledge Management

blocks.zh: Q10 對知識管理的定義強調四個動作：acquiring（獲取）→ analysing（分析）→ storing（儲存）→ disseminating（傳播）。
blocks.en: Q10 defines knowledge management through four actions: acquiring, analysing, storing and disseminating.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這意味著：技術轉移時接收的客戶工藝數據、製程開發中的實驗結果、商業化批次的生產數據，都應被系統性地管理，而非鎖在個別工程師的電腦裡。知識管理是讓 PQS「有記憶」的關鍵機制。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this means that the client process data received at technology transfer, experimental results from process development, and production data from commercial batches should all be managed systematically rather than locked away on individual engineers' computers. Knowledge management is the key mechanism that gives the PQS a "memory".

blocks.zh: Product Realisation（產品實現）
blocks.en: Product Realisation

blocks.zh: 這是 ICH Q10 三大目標之一。注意其定義包含三個層面的客戶：
blocks.en: This is one of the three main objectives of ICH Q10. Note that its definition covers three kinds of customer:

blocks.zh: Patients（病人）：最終使用者，安全性與有效性
blocks.en: Patients: the end users; safety and efficacy

blocks.zh: Healthcare professionals + Regulatory authorities：外部監管需求
blocks.en: Healthcare professionals + Regulatory authorities: external regulatory needs

blocks.zh: Internal customers：內部下游製程、包裝、倉儲等需求
blocks.en: Internal customers: the needs of downstream processes, packaging, warehousing and so on

blocks.zh: Product Realisation 不只是「做出產品」，而是「做出符合所有利害關係人需求的產品」。
blocks.en: Product Realisation is not just "making the product", but "making a product that meets the needs of all stakeholders".

blocks.zh: State of Control vs. State of Compliance 重要辨別
blocks.en: State of Control vs. State of Compliance: An Important Distinction

blocks.zh: State of Compliance（合規狀態）：你的產品/製程符合法規要求和規格書——這是最低門檻，是「達標」。
blocks.en: State of Compliance: your product/process meets regulatory requirements and specifications. This is the minimum threshold: you have "met the standard".

blocks.zh: State of Control（控制狀態）：你的一組控制措施能持續地（consistently）保證製程效能和產品品質——這是主動管理，是「掌控」。
blocks.en: State of Control: a set of controls that consistently provides assurance of continued process performance and product quality. This is proactive management: you are "in command".

blocks.zh: 打個比方：一輛車的煞車片剛好在磨耗限制值（符合規格）是 State of Compliance；而一個完善的車輛維護系統，能在煞車片接近磨耗前就提前更換，確保煞車效能始終良好，才是 State of Control。
blocks.en: An analogy: a car whose brake pads are right at the wear limit (within specification) is in a State of Compliance. A well-run vehicle maintenance system that replaces the brake pads before they approach the wear limit, so that braking performance is always good, is a State of Control.

blocks.zh: FDA 的立場：State of Control 是 FDA CDER 在 PQAS（Process Quality Assurance Section）稽查中評估廠商的重要維度。單純「沒有 OOS」不等於 State of Control——你還需要展示趨勢管理、預防性維護、定期製程能力評估（PPQR）等機制。
blocks.en: The FDA position: State of Control is an important dimension that FDA CDER evaluates in PQAS (Process Quality Assurance Section) inspections. Simply having "no OOS" does not equal State of Control. You also need to demonstrate trend management, preventive maintenance, periodic process capability assessment (PPQR) and similar mechanisms.

blocks.zh: 定義來自 ICH Q9。Q10 詞彙表納入此術語，明確表示 QRM 是 PQS 的Enabler（使能者）——它不是一個獨立的活動，而是貫穿 PQS 所有元素的工具。
blocks.en: The definition comes from ICH Q9. By including this term, the Q10 glossary makes clear that QRM is an Enabler of the PQS: it is not a stand-alone activity but a tool that runs through every element of the PQS.

blocks.zh: Q9 定義的四個步驟：assessment → control → communication → review，對應到 PQS 中的 FMEA、HACCP、ICH Q9 工具（Ishikawa、FTA 等）。
blocks.en: The four steps in the Q9 definition (assessment, control, communication, review) map onto FMEA, HACCP and the ICH Q9 tools (Ishikawa, FTA, etc.) used in the PQS.

blocks.zh: Quality Manual（品質手冊）的 CDMO 意義
blocks.en: What the Quality Manual Means for a CDMO

blocks.zh: Q10 要求公司建立並維護 Quality Manual，描述整個 PQS 的架構。對 CDMO 而言，Quality Manual 往往是客戶稽查（Client Audit）和法規稽查（PAI）的第一份參考文件。一本結構清晰、反映 Q10 架構的 Quality Manual，能有效建立稽查員的信任感。
blocks.en: Q10 requires a company to establish and maintain a Quality Manual describing the structure of the whole PQS. For a CDMO, the Quality Manual is often the first reference document for client audits and regulatory inspections (PAI). A clearly structured Quality Manual that reflects the Q10 framework helps build the inspector's trust.

blocks.zh: Quality Manual 應涵蓋：範圍、政策、架構圖、PQS 要素索引
blocks.en: The Quality Manual should cover: scope, policy, a structure diagram, and an index of PQS elements

blocks.zh: 不需要揭露所有細節，但需顯示系統的完整性與連結性
blocks.en: It need not disclose every detail, but should show that the system is complete and its parts are linked

blocks.zh: GDUFA PDUFA 環境下，PAI 前準備 Quality Manual 已成為業界慣例
blocks.en: In the GDUFA and PDUFA environment, preparing the Quality Manual ahead of a PAI has become standard industry practice

blocks.en: Glossary Master Table: Full Terminology Reference

blocks.zh: 英文原文定義對照表
blocks.en: Table of Original English Definitions

blocks.zh: ICH Q 三部曲整合比喻：建築師 + 安全顧問 + 物業管理系統
blocks.en: An Analogy for the Q8, Q9 and Q10 Trilogy: Architect + Safety Consultant + Building Management System

blocks.zh: Q8（Design / 設計者）= 建築師：負責用科學方法設計一棟品質優異的建築——選材、結構、Design Space（建築公差範圍）、Control Strategy（施工驗收標準）。
blocks.en: Q8 (Design) = the architect: uses a scientific approach to design a building of excellent quality: choice of materials, structure, Design Space (the tolerance range of the building), Control Strategy (the construction acceptance criteria).

blocks.zh: Q9（Risk / 風險評估師）= 安全顧問：評估建築的每一個環節可能出現什麼風險——火災、地震、漏水。用 FMEA、FTA 等工具識別優先處理的風險，提供給建築師和物業管理者參考。
blocks.en: Q9 (Risk) = the safety consultant: assesses what risks could arise at every point in the building: fire, earthquake, water leaks. Uses tools such as FMEA and FTA to identify the risks to address first, and passes these to the architect and the building manager for reference.

blocks.zh: Q10（System / 物業管理系統）= 建築管理系統 (BMS)：建築完工後，24/7 監控每一個系統（電力、空調、消防）是否正常運作。發現異常立刻啟動 CAPA；定期進行管理審查；確保建築在整個生命週期內持續處於 State of Control。
blocks.en: Q10 (System) = the building management system (BMS): once the building is complete, monitors every system (power, HVAC, fire protection) 24/7 to confirm it is working normally. Starts CAPA immediately when an abnormality is found, performs regular management reviews, and ensures that the building remains in a State of Control throughout its lifecycle.

blocks.zh: 沒有 BMS（Q10）的建築，即使設計再完美，隨著時間推移也會退化。沒有建築師（Q8）的 BMS，管理的是一棟不知道重要節點在哪裡的建築。三者缺一不可。
blocks.en: A building without a BMS (Q10) will deteriorate over time, however perfect the design. A BMS without an architect (Q8) manages a building without knowing where the critical points are. None of the three can be left out.

blocks.zh: Q 三部曲術語重疊分析
blocks.en: Overlap Analysis of Terms across Q8, Q9 and Q10

blocks.zh: Q8 → Q10 重疊術語：
blocks.en: Terms shared between Q8 and Q10:

blocks.zh: Design Space（定義在 Q8，Q10 沿用）
blocks.en: Design Space (defined in Q8, adopted in Q10)

blocks.zh: Control Strategy（Q10 擴充 Q8 概念，增加系統性定義）
blocks.en: Control Strategy (Q10 extends the Q8 concept and adds a systematic definition)

blocks.zh: Product and Process Understanding（概念基礎）
blocks.en: Product and Process Understanding (the conceptual foundation)

blocks.zh: Q9 → Q10 重疊術語：
blocks.en: Terms shared between Q9 and Q10:

blocks.zh: Quality Risk Management（定義在 Q9，Q10 列為 Enabler）
blocks.en: Quality Risk Management (defined in Q9, listed in Q10 as an Enabler)

blocks.zh: Quality（定義在 Q9，Q10 沿用）
blocks.en: Quality (defined in Q9, adopted in Q10)

blocks.zh: ISO 9000 → Q10 共用術語（7項）： Capability of Process, Continual Improvement, Corrective/Preventive Action, Quality Manual, Quality Objectives, Quality Planning, Quality Policy
blocks.en: Terms shared between ISO 9000 and Q10 (7 terms): Capability of Process, Continual Improvement, Corrective/Preventive Action, Quality Manual, Quality Objectives, Quality Planning, Quality Policy

blocks.zh: Annex 1 — Potential Opportunities to Enhance Science and Risk-Based Regulatory Approaches｜強化科學及風險導向法規途徑的潛在機會（第 20 頁）
blocks.en: Annex 1: Potential Opportunities to Enhance Science and Risk-Based Regulatory Approaches (page 20)

blocks.zh: 風險導向稽查（Risk-Based Inspections）的實務意義
blocks.en: Practical Meaning of Risk-Based Inspections

blocks.zh: 當廠商展現有效的 PQS（Scenario 2），法規機關可以實施風險導向稽查，包含：
blocks.en: When a manufacturer demonstrates an effective PQS (Scenario 2), the regulatory authority can apply risk-based inspection, which includes:

blocks.zh: 稽查頻率降低：歷史良好的廠商，FDA CDER 可能由每 2 年稽查一次改為每 3-4 年
blocks.en: Lower inspection frequency: for a manufacturer with a good history, FDA CDER may move from inspecting every 2 years to every 3-4 years

blocks.zh: 稽查範疇縮小：稽查員可根據廠商的 Annual Product Review 和 PPQR，優先聚焦高風險品項
blocks.en: Narrower inspection scope: inspectors can use the manufacturer's Annual Product Review and PPQR to focus first on the highest-risk products

blocks.zh: Surveillance vs. For-Cause：有效 PQS 使廠商主要面對例行性 surveillance inspection，而非因召回/OOS 觸發的 for-cause inspection
blocks.en: Surveillance vs. For-Cause: an effective PQS means the manufacturer mainly faces routine surveillance inspections rather than for-cause inspections triggered by recalls or OOS results

blocks.zh: 實例：FDA GDUFA 制度下，廠商的 GDUFA 費用與稽查頻率掛鉤。具備成熟 PQS 的廠商在歷史稽查記錄良好時，往往進入較低頻率的稽查週期。
blocks.en: Example: under the FDA GDUFA system, a manufacturer's GDUFA fees are linked to inspection frequency. A manufacturer with a mature PQS and a good inspection history often moves into a lower-frequency inspection cycle.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用：PAI 準備與 PQS 成熟度
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: PAI Preparation and PQS Maturity

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，Annex 1 的意義尤為重要：
blocks.en: Annex 1 is especially important for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: Pre-Approval Inspection (PAI)：FDA 在批准 NDA/ANDA 前對製造廠進行的稽查。一個成熟的 PQS（Scenario 4）能讓 PAI 稽查員快速建立信心，縮短稽查時間，降低 Form 483 觀察意見的機率。
blocks.en: Pre-Approval Inspection (PAI): an FDA inspection of the manufacturing site before an NDA/ANDA is approved. A mature PQS (Scenario 4) lets the PAI inspector build confidence quickly, shortens the inspection, and lowers the likelihood of Form 483 observations.

blocks.zh: GDUFA 承諾的審查時限：FDA 對 GDUFA 下的 ANDA 承諾在 10 個月內完成審查，但若 PAI 有問題，整個時程拖延。一個準備完善的 PQS 是「不拖審查時程」的保險。
blocks.en: GDUFA review goal dates: FDA commits to completing review of an ANDA under GDUFA within 10 months, but if there is a problem at the PAI, the whole timeline slips. A well-prepared PQS is insurance against delaying the review timeline.

blocks.zh: 客戶談判籌碼：CDMO 可向客戶展示其 PQS 成熟度（甚至有 FDA 的稽查歷史記錄），作為「降低客戶法規風險」的服務賣點。
blocks.en: Leverage in client negotiations: a CDMO can show clients the maturity of its PQS (even its FDA inspection history) as a selling point: "reducing the client's regulatory risk".

blocks.zh: Science-based review（情境 3）：當 CDMO 協助客戶建立完整的 Process Understanding（Q8 QbD），在 FDA CMC 審查階段，審查員能更快速地理解和批准產品——縮短審查週期對客戶的 commercial launch 時間線至關重要。
blocks.en: Science-based review (Scenario 3): when a CDMO helps a client build full Process Understanding (Q8 QbD), reviewers in the FDA CMC review can understand and approve the product more quickly. A shorter review cycle is critical to the client's commercial launch timeline.

blocks.zh: 比喻：信用分數與貸款利率
blocks.en: Analogy: Credit Score and Loan Interest Rate

blocks.zh: Annex 1 就像金融界的信用評級系統。一個廠商（借款人）只要「符合 GMP」（scenario 1），就像信用分數在最低門檻——可以借到錢，但利率最高（稽查最頻繁、審查最嚴格）。
blocks.en: Annex 1 works like a credit rating system in finance. A manufacturer (the borrower) that merely "complies with GMP" (Scenario 1) is like a credit score at the minimum threshold: it can borrow, but at the highest interest rate (most frequent inspections, strictest review).

blocks.zh: 隨著廠商建立更成熟的 PQS 並累積良好的稽查記錄，「信用分數」提升——開始享有更低的「利率」（更少的稽查、更快的審查、更大的批准後變更彈性）。
blocks.en: As the manufacturer builds a more mature PQS and accumulates a good inspection record, its "credit score" rises and it starts to enjoy a lower "interest rate" (fewer inspections, faster reviews, greater flexibility for post-approval changes).

blocks.zh: 這個比喻說明為什麼 PQS 是長期投資，而非短期成本：初期建立 Q10 相容的 PQS 需要資源，但長期累積的法規信任，為公司帶來持續的商業回報。
blocks.en: This analogy shows why the PQS is a long-term investment rather than a short-term cost: building a Q10-compatible PQS takes resources at first, but the regulatory trust accumulated over time brings the company lasting commercial returns.

blocks.zh: Annex 1 核心邏輯：PQS 成熟度 → 法規彈性矩陣
blocks.en: Core Logic of Annex 1: PQS Maturity to Regulatory Flexibility Matrix

blocks.zh: Annex 1 的精髓是一個漸進式的回報矩陣：你對 Q8/Q9/Q10 實施的深度，直接決定你能從法規機關獲得什麼樣的彈性。
blocks.en: The essence of Annex 1 is a progressive reward matrix: the depth to which you implement Q8/Q9/Q10 directly determines the flexibility you can obtain from regulatory authorities.

blocks.zh: Annex 2 — ICH Q10 PQS Model Diagram｜ICH Q10 藥品品質系統模型圖（第 21 頁）
blocks.en: Annex 2: ICH Q10 PQS Model Diagram (page 21)

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text + HTML 視覺化重建
blocks.en: Original Text + HTML Visual Reconstruction

blocks.zh: PQS 模型圖解析：三層架構 × 四個生命週期
blocks.en: Reading the PQS Model Diagram: Three Layers × Four Lifecycle Stages

blocks.zh: Annex 2 的模型圖是 ICH Q10 的「架構總圖」，用水平方向（時間軸）× 垂直方向（系統層次）的二維矩陣，展示 PQS 如何貫穿整個產品生命週期。
blocks.en: The model diagram in Annex 2 is the "master architecture chart" of ICH Q10. Using a two-dimensional matrix, with the horizontal direction as the timeline and the vertical direction as the system level, it shows how the PQS runs through the whole product lifecycle.

blocks.zh: 水平軸：四大生命週期階段
blocks.en: Horizontal axis: the four lifecycle stages

blocks.zh: Pharmaceutical Development（藥品開發）：建立 QTPP、CQA、Design Space、Control Strategy
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical Development: establish the QTPP, CQAs, Design Space and Control Strategy

blocks.zh: Technology Transfer（技術轉移）：將開發知識正確傳遞至商業化生產場址，涵蓋製程 scale-up 和廠址驗證
blocks.en: Technology Transfer: transfer development knowledge correctly to the commercial manufacturing site, including process scale-up and site validation

blocks.zh: Commercial Manufacturing（商業化製造）：PQS 的主戰場——PPQMS、CAPA、Change Management 全力運作
blocks.en: Commercial Manufacturing: the main arena of the PQS, where PPQMS, CAPA and Change Management operate at full strength

blocks.zh: Product Discontinuation（產品停產）：退市計劃、留樣管理、技術文件封存，確保患者的持續供應過渡
blocks.en: Product Discontinuation: market withdrawal planning, retention sample management and archiving of technical documents, ensuring a smooth transition for continued patient supply

blocks.zh: 垂直軸：三大系統層次
blocks.en: Vertical axis: the three system levels

blocks.zh: Management Responsibilities（管理層責任）：頂層驅動力，確保 PQS 有資源、有政策、有文化
blocks.en: Management Responsibilities: the top-level driving force, ensuring the PQS has resources, policy and culture

blocks.zh: PQS Elements（PQS 要素）：Section 3 的四大要素——PPQMS、CAPA、Change Management、Management Review
blocks.en: PQS Elements: the four elements in Section 3: PPQMS, CAPA, Change Management and Management Review

blocks.zh: PQS Enablers（使能者）：知識管理（KM）和品質風險管理（QRM），是底層的基礎設施
blocks.en: PQS Enablers: Knowledge Management (KM) and Quality Risk Management (QRM), the underlying infrastructure

blocks.zh: Technology Transfer（技術轉移）——CDMO 的核心業務
blocks.en: Technology Transfer: the Core Business of a CDMO

blocks.zh: 模型圖中的 Technology Transfer 阶段，對 CDMO 而言往往是最頻繁、最複雜的階段（每個新客戶/新產品都要歷經一次）。Q10 PQS 在這個階段的核心任務：
blocks.en: The Technology Transfer stage in the model diagram is often the most frequent and most complex stage for a CDMO (every new client or product goes through it). The core tasks of the Q10 PQS at this stage are:

blocks.zh: 知識傳遞（Knowledge Transfer）：確保開發階段的 Process Understanding 完整傳遞到 CDMO 端，包括 CPP 範圍、CQA 連結、FMEA 結果
blocks.en: Knowledge Transfer: ensure that the Process Understanding from development is fully passed to the CDMO, including CPP ranges, CQA linkages and FMEA results

blocks.zh: 製程驗證橋接（Validation Bridging）：小試/中試數據如何支持商業化規模的 PPQ 設計
blocks.en: Validation Bridging: how lab-scale and pilot-scale data support the design of the PPQ at commercial scale

blocks.zh: Change Management 的關鍵性：技術轉移中任何偏離開發規格的改動，都需要正式的 Change Management 流程，確保法規透明度
blocks.en: Criticality of Change Management: any change during technology transfer that departs from the development specifications requires a formal Change Management process, to ensure regulatory transparency

blocks.zh: CAPA 預先準備：在技術轉移階段，預先識別可能的失敗模式（FMEA），建立相應的 CAPA 預案
blocks.en: Advance CAPA preparation: during technology transfer, identify potential failure modes in advance (FMEA) and put corresponding CAPA contingency plans in place

blocks.zh: CDMO 視角：PQS 成熟度如何改善法規關係
blocks.en: The CDMO Perspective: How PQS Maturity Improves Regulatory Relationships

blocks.zh: 一個成熟 CDMO 的 PQS 帶來的具體法規關係改善：
blocks.en: Specific improvements in regulatory relationships that a mature CDMO PQS brings:

blocks.zh: FDA PAI 通過率提升：有完整 PPQMS 記錄（PPQR/APR）的廠商，PAI 時能提供充分的歷史績效數據，稽查員能快速建立信心
blocks.en: Higher FDA PAI pass rate: a manufacturer with complete PPQMS records (PPQR/APR) can provide ample historical performance data at the PAI, so inspectors build confidence quickly

blocks.zh: EMA GMP 稽查頻率：EMA 對有效 PQS 的廠商適用風險導向稽查週期（依 EudraGMDP 評分），可能延長兩次稽查之間的間隔
blocks.en: EMA GMP inspection frequency: EMA applies a risk-based inspection interval to manufacturers with an effective PQS (based on EudraGMDP scoring), which may lengthen the interval between inspections

blocks.zh: 客戶稽查（Client Audit）效率：新客戶送來的 RFQ 都包含廠商問卷和廠址稽查。成熟 PQS 的廠商能以系統性文件回應，減少「稽查成本」（人時）
blocks.en: Client audit efficiency: RFQs from new clients come with supplier questionnaires and site audits. A manufacturer with a mature PQS can respond with systematic documentation, reducing "audit cost" (person-hours)

blocks.zh: ANDA/NDA CMC 審查加速：當 CDMO 為客戶建立了完整的 Q8 Process Understanding，FDA CMC 審查員能更快速完成技術審查，縮短批准時間線
blocks.en: Faster ANDA/NDA CMC review: when a CDMO has built full Q8 Process Understanding for a client, FDA CMC reviewers can complete the technical review more quickly, shortening the approval timeline

blocks.zh: 全文總複習 Comprehensive Review Questions｜涵蓋 ICH Q10 完整內容
blocks.en: Comprehensive Review Questions: Covering the Whole of ICH Q10

blocks.zh: 綜合複習 Full Q10 Document Review
blocks.en: Full Q10 Document Review

blocks.zh: 練習題 Practice Questions（涵蓋 ICH Q10 全文四大章節）
blocks.en: Practice Questions (covering the four main sections of ICH Q10)

blocks.zh: [Section 1 + Annex 1] PQS 成熟度與法規回報
blocks.en: [Section 1 + Annex 1] PQS Maturity and Regulatory Rewards

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 的 A 廠（台灣）正在申請 FDA ANDA 產品的 Pre-Approval Inspection。該廠已有 5 年的 ICH Q10 相容 PQS，並定期進行 Annual Product Review 和製程能力評估（Cpk 持續 > 1.33）。請問：
blocks.en: Site A (Taiwan) of a CDMO is undergoing a Pre-Approval Inspection for an FDA ANDA product. The site has had an ICH Q10-compatible PQS for 5 years and regularly performs Annual Product Reviews and process capability assessments (Cpk consistently > 1.33). Questions:

blocks.zh: 根據 Annex 1，該廠處於哪個 Scenario？能獲得哪些法規層面的機會？
blocks.en: According to Annex 1, which Scenario is the site in? What regulatory opportunities can it obtain?

blocks.zh: 稽查員在 PAI 中會聚焦哪些 PQS 指標來確認「State of Control」？
blocks.en: Which PQS indicators will the inspector focus on during the PAI to confirm "State of Control"?

blocks.zh: 若稽查員發現 CAPA 系統存在 root cause 分析不足的問題，這代表 Q10 的哪個 PQS 要素有缺陷？
blocks.en: If the inspector finds that the CAPA system has inadequate root cause analysis, which Q10 PQS element is deficient?

blocks.zh: [Section 2 + Glossary] 管理層責任與術語應用
blocks.en: [Section 2 + Glossary] Management Responsibilities and Use of Terms

blocks.zh: 一位新上任的 Site Quality Director 正在審查公司的 Quality Manual。他注意到 Quality Policy 只有一句話「我們致力生產安全有效的藥品」，且近三年沒有更新。請問：
blocks.en: A newly appointed Site Quality Director is reviewing the company's Quality Manual. He notices that the Quality Policy is a single sentence, "We are committed to producing safe and effective medicines", and has not been updated in three years. Questions:

blocks.zh: 根據 Q10，Quality Policy 應包含哪些要素？現有政策有哪些缺陷？
blocks.en: According to Q10, what elements should a Quality Policy contain? What are the shortcomings of the current policy?

blocks.zh: Quality Objectives（品質目標）應如何與 Quality Policy 連結？請舉出 2 個符合 Q10 要求的 Quality Objective 例子。
blocks.en: How should Quality Objectives be linked to the Quality Policy? Give 2 examples of Quality Objectives that meet Q10 requirements.

blocks.zh: Management Review（管理審查）與 Management Review of PP&PQ（製程效能審查）有何不同？前者在 Section 4，後者在 Section 3.2.4，差別是什麼？
blocks.en: How does Management Review differ from Management Review of PP&PQ (process performance review)? The former is in Section 4 and the latter in Section 3.2.4. What is the difference?

blocks.zh: [Section 3 + Annex 2] PQS 四大要素整合應用
blocks.en: [Section 3 + Annex 2] Integrated Application of the Four PQS Elements

blocks.zh: 一批注射劑產品在 APR（Annual Product Review）中發現，近 12 個月的無菌測試（Sterility Test）陽性率從 0.1% 上升至 0.8%（雖仍在規格內，但呈明顯上升趨勢）。請問：
blocks.en: In the APR (Annual Product Review) of an injectable product, the sterility test positive rate over the last 12 months is found to have risen from 0.1% to 0.8% (still within specification, but a clear upward trend). Questions:

blocks.zh: 依據 PPQMS（Section 3.2.1），此趨勢應觸發哪些行動？
blocks.en: Under PPQMS (Section 3.2.1), what actions should this trend trigger?

blocks.zh: 若調查後確認為空調過濾器（HEPA filter）更換週期過長，應透過哪個 PQS 要素（CAPA vs. Change Management）處理？兩者如何協作？
blocks.en: If the investigation confirms that the HEPA filter replacement interval in the air handling system was too long, through which PQS element (CAPA vs. Change Management) should it be handled? How do the two work together?

blocks.zh: 根據 Annex 2 的 PQS 模型，Knowledge Management（知識管理）在此事件中扮演什麼角色？哪些知識應被儲存和傳播？
blocks.en: According to the PQS model in Annex 2, what role does Knowledge Management play in this event? What knowledge should be stored and disseminated?

blocks.zh: [全文整合 + Q 三部曲] Q8 + Q9 + Q10 綜合分析
blocks.en: [Whole Document + Q8/Q9/Q10 Trilogy] Combined Analysis of Q8 + Q9 + Q10

blocks.zh: 一家製藥公司計劃將其口服固體劑型的製造從傳統方法（wet granulation, batch process）轉型為連續製造（continuous manufacturing, CM）。這是一個重大的技術革新。請從 Q 三部曲角度分析：
blocks.en: A pharmaceutical company plans to move the manufacture of an oral solid dosage form from a traditional method (wet granulation, batch process) to continuous manufacturing (CM). This is a major technological innovation. Analyze it from the perspective of the Q8/Q9/Q10 trilogy:

blocks.zh: 在 Q8 層面：連續製造的 Design Space 與傳統批次製程的 Design Space 有何本質差異？需要哪些額外的開發數據？
blocks.en: At the Q8 level: how does the Design Space of continuous manufacturing differ in essence from that of a traditional batch process? What additional development data are needed?

blocks.zh: 在 Q9 層面：連續製造引入了哪些新的風險？適用哪些 QRM 工具（FMEA、HACCP、FTA）進行評估？
blocks.en: At the Q9 level: what new risks does continuous manufacturing introduce? Which QRM tools (FMEA, HACCP, FTA) apply for the assessment?

blocks.zh: 在 Q10 層面：Change Management System 應如何處理此「重大變更」？需要哪些 PQS 文件（change request, risk assessment, validation report, regulatory notification）？
blocks.en: At the Q10 level: how should the Change Management System handle this "major change"? Which PQS documents are needed (change request, risk assessment, validation report, regulatory notification)?

blocks.zh: 最終，若成功實施連續製造並建立即時放行（RTRT），根據 Annex 1 的矩陣，公司處於哪個 Scenario？能獲得哪些法規機會？
blocks.en: Finally, if continuous manufacturing is implemented successfully and real-time release testing (RTRT) is established, which Scenario in the Annex 1 matrix is the company in? What regulatory opportunities can it obtain?

blocks.zh: 解題思路提示 Analytical Framework
blocks.en: Analytical Framework for the Answers

blocks.zh: 題目一解題框架
blocks.en: Question 1 Framework

blocks.zh: 此題考核 Annex 1 的情境識別 + State of Control 的操作性定義。
blocks.en: This question tests Annex 1 scenario identification and the operational definition of State of Control.

blocks.zh: 有效 PQS（Q10）+ 產品/製程理解（Q8）+ QRM（Q9）→ Scenario 4（最高等級）
blocks.en: Effective PQS (Q10) + product/process understanding (Q8) + QRM (Q9) = Scenario 4 (the highest level)

blocks.zh: PAI 關注的 State of Control 指標：APR 完整性、CAPA 有效性、PPQR 趨勢分析、製程能力指數（Cpk）
blocks.en: State of Control indicators the PAI focuses on: completeness of the APR, CAPA effectiveness, PPQR trend analysis, process capability indices (Cpk)

blocks.zh: CAPA root cause 不足 → Section 3.2.2 CAPA System 缺陷，具體是「investigate the cause」步驟不充分
blocks.en: Inadequate CAPA root cause analysis points to a deficiency in the Section 3.2.2 CAPA System, specifically an insufficient "investigate the cause" step

blocks.zh: 題目二解題框架
blocks.en: Question 2 Framework

blocks.zh: 考核 Management Responsibilities（Section 2）的實操性理解。
blocks.en: Tests practical understanding of Management Responsibilities (Section 2).

blocks.zh: Quality Policy 應包含：品質承諾、組織的適用性說明、可提供建立/審查 Quality Objectives 的框架、需要被溝通並理解（Section 2.1 要求）
blocks.en: A Quality Policy should include: a quality commitment, a statement of applicability to the organization, a framework for establishing/reviewing Quality Objectives, and a requirement that it be communicated and understood (required by Section 2.1)

blocks.zh: Quality Objective 例子：「2026 年 CAPA 按時關閉率 > 95%」、「全廠 Cpk > 1.33 的製程佔比達 80%」
blocks.en: Examples of Quality Objectives: "CAPA on-time closure rate > 95% in 2026" and "80% of site processes with Cpk > 1.33"

blocks.zh: Section 4（PQS 管理審查）= 評估 PQS 本身的健全性；Section 3.2.4（PP&PQ 管理審查）= 評估特定產品的製程效能
blocks.en: Section 4 (PQS management review) = evaluates the soundness of the PQS itself; Section 3.2.4 (PP&PQ management review) = evaluates the process performance of specific products

blocks.zh: 題目三解題框架
blocks.en: Question 3 Framework

blocks.zh: 考核 PPQMS + CAPA + Change Management 的協作機制。
blocks.en: Tests how PPQMS, CAPA and Change Management work together.

blocks.zh: PPQMS 偵測到趨勢 → 觸發 formal investigation（偏差報告）→ CAPA（消除根本原因：HEPA 更換週期過長 → 修訂 PM 計劃）
blocks.en: PPQMS detects a trend, which triggers a formal investigation (deviation report), then CAPA (eliminate the root cause: HEPA replacement interval too long, so revise the PM plan)

blocks.zh: 修訂預防性維護計劃（PM Schedule）= 計劃性變更 → 需 Change Management（評估對製程和產品品質的影響，可能無需法規申報）
blocks.en: Revising the preventive maintenance plan (PM schedule) is a planned change, so Change Management is needed (assess the impact on the process and product quality; regulatory filing may not be required)

blocks.zh: Knowledge Management 角色：此事件的調查報告、根本原因分析、CAPA 有效性評估，應作為廠址「環境監控知識庫」的一部分，供未來的 APR 和訓練使用
blocks.en: Role of Knowledge Management: the investigation report, root cause analysis and CAPA effectiveness assessment for this event should become part of the site's "environmental monitoring knowledge base", for use in future APRs and training

blocks.zh: 題目四解題框架（Q 三部曲整合）
blocks.en: Question 4 Framework (Integration of the Q8/Q9/Q10 Trilogy)

blocks.zh: 此題是最高難度的整合題，考核 Q 三部曲在「技術革新」場景中的協同作用。
blocks.en: This is the most difficult integration question, testing how the three guidelines work together in a "technological innovation" scenario.

blocks.zh: Q8 面向：連續製造的 Design Space 需涵蓋時間維度（穩態的建立時間）和物料屬性的即時變異，通常用 PAT（NIR、拉曼）建立即時監測，比傳統批次製程更複雜
blocks.en: Q8 aspect: the Design Space for continuous manufacturing must cover the time dimension (the time needed to reach steady state) and real-time variability of material attributes. Real-time monitoring is usually built with PAT (NIR, Raman), which is more complex than a traditional batch process

blocks.zh: Q9 面向：新風險包括穩態過渡期的品質保證、多設備串聯的失效模式傳遞、PAT 感測器失效的影響。FMEA 最適合識別設備層級失效；HACCP 適合整個製程流程的危害分析
blocks.en: Q9 aspect: new risks include quality assurance during the transition to steady state, propagation of failure modes across equipment connected in series, and the impact of PAT sensor failure. FMEA is best for identifying equipment-level failures; HACCP suits hazard analysis of the whole process flow

blocks.zh: Q10 面向：此為「Major Change」，需要 Prior Approval Supplement（PAS）向 FDA 申報。Change Management 文件包：(1) Change Request, (2) Impact Assessment, (3) Risk Assessment（引用 Q9 FMEA 結果）, (4) Validation Protocol & Report（PPQ）, (5) Regulatory Strategy Memo
blocks.en: Q10 aspect: this is a "Major Change" that requires a Prior Approval Supplement (PAS) filing with FDA. The Change Management document package: (1) Change Request, (2) Impact Assessment, (3) Risk Assessment (citing Q9 FMEA results), (4) Validation Protocol & Report (PPQ), (5) Regulatory Strategy Memo

blocks.zh: Annex 1 定位：成功實施連續製造 + RTRT + 完整 PQS = Scenario 4。法規機會：science-based review of post-approval changes（未來製程優化無需頻繁申報）+ risk-based inspections + innovative process validation（連續製造的驗證方法創新）
blocks.en: Annex 1 positioning: successful continuous manufacturing + RTRT + a complete PQS = Scenario 4. Regulatory opportunities: science-based review of post-approval changes (future process optimization without frequent filings) + risk-based inspections + innovative process validation (new validation approaches for continuous manufacturing)

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 完整文件總結 Complete Document Summary
blocks.en: Complete Document Summary of ICH Q10

blocks.zh: 定位與整合：ICH Q10 是製藥品質系統的最高層框架，以 ISO 9001 品質管理體系為基礎，整合 ICH Q8（藥品開發）和 Q9（風險管理），形成「Q 三部曲」——Q8 設計品質、Q9 管理風險、Q10 維護系統
blocks.en: Position and integration: ICH Q10 is the top-level framework for pharmaceutical quality systems. Built on the ISO 9001 quality management system, it integrates ICH Q8 (pharmaceutical development) and Q9 (risk management) to form the "Q trilogy": Q8 designs quality, Q9 manages risk, Q10 maintains the system

blocks.zh: 三大目標：① Product Realisation（滿足所有利害關係人的產品品質需求）；② State of Control（持續主動管理製程變異）；③ Continual Improvement（週期性強化 PQS 能力）
blocks.en: Three main objectives: (1) Product Realisation (meeting the product quality needs of all stakeholders); (2) State of Control (proactively managing process variability on a continuing basis); (3) Continual Improvement (periodically strengthening PQS capability)

blocks.zh: 四大 PQS 要素（Section 3）：PPQMS（製程效能監控系統）→ CAPA（糾偏預防行動）→ Change Management System（變更管理）→ Management Review of PP&PQ（製程效能管理審查）
blocks.en: Four PQS elements (Section 3): PPQMS (process performance and product quality monitoring system) → CAPA (corrective and preventive action) → Change Management System → Management Review of PP&PQ (management review of process performance and product quality)

blocks.zh: 兩大 Enablers：Knowledge Management（系統性知識管理）+ Quality Risk Management（品質風險管理，來自 Q9）——這兩者是 PQS 的底層基礎設施，貫穿四大生命週期
blocks.en: Two Enablers: Knowledge Management (systematic knowledge management) + Quality Risk Management (from Q9). These two are the underlying infrastructure of the PQS and run through all four lifecycle stages

blocks.zh: Annex 1 核心訊息：PQS 成熟度（Scenario 1 → 4）決定廠商能從法規機關獲得的彈性程度；Q8+Q9+Q10 全整合（Scenario 4）帶來最大的法規機會，包括風險導向稽查、科學導向審查、批准後變更優化、RTRT
blocks.en: Core message of Annex 1: PQS maturity (Scenario 1 to 4) determines the degree of flexibility a manufacturer can obtain from regulatory authorities; full integration of Q8+Q9+Q10 (Scenario 4) brings the greatest regulatory opportunities, including risk-based inspection, science-based review, optimization of post-approval changes, and RTRT

blocks.zh: Annex 2 核心訊息：PQS 模型是二維矩陣——水平軸為四大生命週期（開發→技術轉移→商業化→停產），垂直軸為三層系統（管理層責任→PQS 要素→PQS 使能者）；三大 Q10 目標貫穿整個矩陣
blocks.en: Core message of Annex 2: the PQS model is a two-dimensional matrix. The horizontal axis is the four lifecycle stages (development, technology transfer, commercial manufacturing, discontinuation) and the vertical axis is the three system levels (management responsibilities, PQS elements, PQS enablers); the three Q10 objectives run through the whole matrix

blocks.zh: State of Control vs. Compliance：合規是最低門檻；State of Control 是主動管理製程變異、持續保證品質的進階狀態——這是 Q10 對製藥業的根本要求升級
blocks.en: State of Control vs. Compliance: compliance is the minimum threshold; State of Control is the advanced state of proactively managing process variability and continuously assuring quality. This is the fundamental step up that Q10 asks of the pharmaceutical industry

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務要義：技術轉移是 CDMO 最頻繁面對的生命週期階段；成熟 PQS 直接影響 PAI 通過率、客戶稽查效率、和長期法規關係；Quality Manual 是 PQS 對外展示的「門面」
blocks.en: Key takeaways for CDMOs: technology transfer is the lifecycle stage a CDMO faces most often; a mature PQS directly affects PAI pass rates, client audit efficiency and long-term regulatory relationships; the Quality Manual is the "front door" through which the PQS is presented externally
